primary_comparison: Original20Hz55k generator versus full Native30 v7. The independent55k+EXO residual branch is a third experiment, not the full new model.

original55k.model: OfflineSceneMI: original AdaGN TemporalUNet+ViT occupancy+BPS MLP+native body+contact head
original55k.initialization: from scratch, completed55000 updates; all generator weights trained
original55k.camera: head-dominant simulated anatomical position/orientation tracks; no dedicated K/mount/uncertainty camera encoder
original55k.tracks: head55%, head+pelvis15%, head+wrists10%, pelvis8%, wrists4%, mixed3%, history5%; shared position/rotation boolean mask
original55k.scene: camera-centered67 BPS + visible occupancy; exact20 first-hit observed static causal prefix/current dynamics; no predicted-body multiscale skin feedback
original55k.loss: coordination_v1 including balanced stance/swing, relative feet, stride, coordination amplitude/relation; RICH contact BCE
original55k.split: legacy internal split;12 EgoBody official TEST recordings historically in TRAIN

full_native30_v7.initialization: from scratch; no old55k loaded; completed ego10000
full_native30_v7.motion_target: reference residual within shared201D diffusion x0;20-step DDIM
full_native30_v7.camera: pose/availability/confidence, normalized K, mount rotation/translation/calibration validity/uncertainty, self/other and real/synthetic types
full_native30_v7.tracks: ordered22-joint encoder; separate position/rotation masks and confidence, derivatives/valid stencils, uncertainty; exo position-only supported
full_native30_v7.reference: observation-only native bone initializer or optional full frontend prior with confidence; actual RGB frontend not connected
full_native30_v7.scene: 16 global occupied patch tokens, dynamic owner tokens,67 native skin anchors at0.08/0.25/0.6m, local normals/owner/velocity, support relation attention1.5/1.25m; observed static recording union plus current dynamics
full_native30_v7.refinement: proposal/final two backbone passes;6-step observation IK at proposal/final; contact/correspondence learned feedback;2-step observed-surface physical guidance inside x0
full_native30_v7.loss: native30 base/body/FK/velocity/acceleration/orientation/foot velocity/planting + observed-track losses + geometric contact/correspondence/support; optional gait_restore NOT enabled in completed10000 config
full_native30_v7.training_modes_completed: ego-only/head-only, all groups; EXO support exists but EXO adaptation not yet trained in this completed phase
full_native30_v7.split: official recording split; reconstructed raw source fingerprints validated; no official TEST examples in new training
full_native30_v7.TRAIN_noise: one50% clean branch; otherwise coherent position/orientation error and optional gap; body/contact GT untouched

independent_exo_branch.model: Frozen original55k absolute-x0 generator as auxiliary prior plus independent temporal EXO residual
independent_exo_branch.base_prior_conditions: sparse controls OFF, scene OFF; four low-noise absolute-x0 passes on observation-only reference. Scene features enter the new residual network, not the frozen old scene encoder.
independent_exo_branch.camera: external calibration used to put inputs in shared coordinates; no full Native30 camera/K/mount encoder in residual network
independent_exo_branch.tracks: visible positions, mask and confidence, inferred reference; no measured exo orientations
independent_exo_branch.scene: one cached nearest static and dynamic patch per reference joint within1.5m; no multiscale67-skin/global patch/dynamic-attention stack or repeated queries
independent_exo_branch.refinement: old prior4 absolute-x0 passes at99/66/33/0, reference retained; independent single-pass local SO3/root residual with branch protection; long-stage input reference smoothing and permission ramp
independent_exo_branch.loss: native30 base plus restored stance/swing/relative feet/stride/coordination,2x hiddenFK and2x observedFK,0.001 residual; long-stage0.05 dedicated foot relation
independent_exo_branch.training_modes: EXO only; rolling max512 cached windows refreshed from15319 eligible TRAIN EXO windows
independent_exo_branch.TRAIN_noise: outer50% noisy selection plus inner50% clean return; expected actual perturbation25%, an unintended double gate
independent_exo_branch.noisy_VAL: not forced;8 of16 nominal noisy windows actually perturbed; clean/noisy label is a mixture
independent_exo_branch.status: saved and stopped at7831 on user's architecture clarification; Adam/pool/sampler/RNG retained
independent_exo_branch.split: new EXO sampling official TRAIN/VAL, but frozen old55k still carries historical TEST overlap
